key_insight: The paper trains an attention graph neural network directly from finite-volume residuals, enabling label-free learning of coupled thermo-fluid fields.
engineering_relevance: This reduces CFD data-generation and storage costs while delivering accurate surrogate predictions for steady and transient thermo-fluid simulations.
method: Build an attention graph neural network on the simulation mesh.
Train it by minimizing finite-volume residuals of the governing equations instead of supervised labels.
Evaluate against CFD references and a data-supervised baseline on four test scenarios.
evidence_signal: Across two steady-state benchmarks, the FVM-loss model reached 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE and closely matched CFD, while on two parametric transient cases it outperformed the supervised baseline without any data-generation cost.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate residual evaluation on the mesh, so implementation quality and stability of the FVM loss are critical.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
